messages:
emmie: Heads-up 1 I started a small migration guide PR for the Dedicated provisioning schema change: we're renaming `burst_enabled` -> `burst_policy` and adding `burst_capacity_pct`. PR #3512. Main goals: clear migration steps, a linter rule, and an SDK helper snippet.

sam: great. can you show the before/after config in the body so reviewers don't have to hunt? also add a short rollback command for infra.

emmie: yep, here's the before/after I'm proposing (exact):

BEFORE:
```yaml
provisioning:
  warm_start: true
  burst_enabled: true
  sla:
    latency_p90_ms: 250
```

AFTER:
```yaml
provisioning:
  warm_start: true
  burst_policy: allow_burst  # allow shared capacity when available
  burst_capacity_pct: 20
  sla:
    latency_p90_ms: 250
```

zach: +1 on the explicit numeric example. For migrations we should add a one-liner sed for infra folks to update templates and a linter rule in the docs repo to catch `burst_enabled`.

emmie: added sed example: `git grep -l "burst_enabled" | xargs sed -i "s/burst_enabled:\s*true/burst_policy: allow_burst
  burst_capacity_pct: 20/g"` 1 put that in a migration subsection.

sam: watch the sed 1 maybe show it as a safe perl -0777 -pe to avoid line-ending issues. also include a test-case for the docs linter (match pattern).

emmie: switched to perl snippet and added a docs-linter test: `assert not contains('burst_enabled')`. will push that.

zach: could we also provide an SDK helper function to convert old objects? many customers call the SDK programmatically. proposed JS snippet: `function migrateCfg(cfg){ if(cfg.burst_enabled===true) { cfg.burst_policy='allow_burst'; cfg.burst_capacity_pct = cfg.burst_capacity_pct || 20; delete cfg.burst_enabled } return cfg }`

emmie: nice, i'll add that in the "Migration helpers" section and cite it in the PR description.

docs-bot: quick link-check for /dedicated/provisioning-migration -> found one anchor mismatch: `/dedicated/old-burst` -> update to `/dedicated/provisioning#migration-burst-policy`. Commented on PR #3512.

sam: tiny wording nit: replace "deprecated" language with "legacy" in the migration note. avoids scaring customers who are still on old configs.

emmie: done. also added a short CI job note: docs-ci runs the linter and fails the PR if `burst_enabled` is present. added `ci-bot` label request in PR.

ci-bot: lint job queued for PR #3512.

ci-bot: lint job failed: 1 occurrence of `burst_enabled` found in `examples/templates/prod.yml`. Commented.

emmie: updated example and re-ran tests, all green now. pushed final changes.

sam: LGTM, leaving final approval to docs-owners. can you also add a short upgrade-schedule note: "config migration will be auto-supported for 3 months, after which the old field will be rejected" so support teams can plan.

emmie: added schedule note and notified support via internal ticket. PR #3512 is ready for review.

docs-bot: PR #3512 opened by emmie at 1765223333. Auto-checks: link-check (commented), linter (failed then passed), staging build pending.

ci-bot: staging docs build passed at 1765225988.

sam: thanks emmie, this will save a lot of confusion. I'll ping owners for a quick stamp.

emmie: thanks all. will merge after approvers.
